question: What explains the many scriptural divisions and arrangements of these powers?
premises: The powers are described with divisions, parts, deficiencies, excesses, and other arrangements.
These descriptions appear in the scriptures.
Their basis is the autonomy of that Lord.
inference: All scriptural differentiations of the powers arise from Śiva's own freedom, not from any external necessity.
plain_english: Even the arrangement of their divisions, parts, deficiencies, excesses, and so on is set forth in the scriptures solely by the force of his autonomy.
